description: observe_assumptions.json: the open-assumptions ledger (req-qualys-observe). Each entry is something this plugin was built on without a recording to check it against, and what a recording would show.

entries.description: One entry per open assumption, in the order the report prints them.

id.description: The entry's stable name; the observation command has one check per id.

question.description: What is not known, as a question about what Qualys returns.

assumption.description: What the plugin does today in the absence of a recording. A recording that agrees settles the entry; one that disagrees contradicts it.

settled_by.description: Which response the observation command reads to decide it, and what it looks for.
